title: Settings
rememberToSave: Remember to click Save Settings after making changes.
importDescription: Select a previous downloaded settings file. Only existing keys will be updated.

messages.unsavedChangesWarning: You have unsaved changes in your settings. Are you sure you want to leave without saving?

descriptions.annotator_collab_response: Whether the comment response functionality is activated.
descriptions.annotator_comments_defaultNumsShown_leve: How many 1st or higher level comments are shown by default.
How many 0-level comments are shown by default when annotation responses are shown
descriptions.annotator_download_enabledBeforeStudyClo: Whether annotations can be downloaded before a study is closed
descriptions.annotator_nlp_activated: Indicates whether NLP support is activated in the annotation view.
descriptions.annotator_nlp_request_timeout: The timeout for the NLP Service request.
descriptions.annotator_nlp_sentiment_analysis_activat: Indicates whether sentiment analysis is activated in the annotation view.
descriptions.annotator_nlp_summarization_annoLength: The minimum length of the annotation to generate a summary.
descriptions.annotator_nlp_summarization_maxLength: The maximum length of the summary (in tokens of the model).
descriptions.annotator_nlp_summarization_minLength: The minimum length of the summary (in tokens of the model).
descriptions.annotator_nlp_summarization_skillName: The skill name to use for summarization.
descriptions.annotator_sidebar_maxWidth: The maximum width of the sidebar (percentage of the screen, in %)
descriptions.annotator_sidebar_minWidth: The minimum width of the sidebar (in px)
descriptions.app_config_copyright: The copyright text to display on the login page
descriptions.app_landing_linkFeedback: The URL to the official feedback page
descriptions.app_landing_linkProject: The URL to the official project page
descriptions.app_landing_showDocs: Whether to show the documentation links on the landing page
descriptions.app_landing_showFeedback: Whether to show the official feedback link on the landing page
descriptions.app_landing_showProject: Whether to show the official project page link on the landing page
descriptions.app_login_forgotPassword: Whether to enable the forgot password functionality or not
descriptions.app_login_passwordResetRateLimit: Rate limit in minutes for password reset emails to prevent spam
descriptions.app_register_acceptDataSharing_default: The default value of whether the user agrees to share data during registration.
descriptions.app_register_acceptStats_default: The default value of whether the user agrees to tracking during registration.
descriptions.app_register_emailVerification: Whether to require email verification for new user accounts
descriptions.app_register_emailVerificationRateLimit: Rate limit in minutes for email verification emails to prevent spam
descriptions.app_register_enabled: Whether self-registration via the public register page is allowed.
descriptions.app_register_requestData: Indicates if the option for data sharing during registration is enabled.
descriptions.app_register_requestName: Whether to request the user's name during registration
descriptions.app_register_requestStats: Whether to request the user's statistics approval during registration
descriptions.app_register_terms: Terms and conditions text to display during registration
descriptions.app_study_enabled: Whether to enable the user study functionality
descriptions.dashboard_navigation_component_default: The default component to display in the dashboard
descriptions.editor_document_showButtonCreate: Show create button in dashboard to create a new html document
descriptions.editor_document_showButtonDeltaDownload: Show download button for document deltas (edits)
descriptions.editor_document_showButtonHTMLDownload: Show download button for document HTML (edits)
descriptions.editor_document_showButtonPDFDownload: Show download button for PDF documents with annotations
descriptions.editor_edits_debounceTime: Delay time in milliseconds before processing edits
descriptions.editor_edits_historyGroupTime: The edits will be merged into groups when there is less than this time between them
descriptions.editor_edits_showHistoryForUser: Show the history of edits for all users (default only admins)
descriptions.editor_toolbar_showHTMLDownload: Show download button for the html document
descriptions.editor_toolbar_tools_background: Text background color in the toolbar
descriptions.editor_toolbar_tools_strike: Strike through text in the toolbar
descriptions.editor_toolbar_visibility: Make toolbar in the editor visible
descriptions.email_template_assignment: Template type for assignment notification emails (Email - Assignment). Leave empty to use default hardcoded email.
descriptions.email_template_passwordReset: Template type for password reset emails (Email - General). Leave empty to use default hardcoded email.
descriptions.email_template_passwordResetSuccess: Template type for password reset success emails (Email - General). Leave empty to use the fallback email from disk.
descriptions.email_template_registration: Template type for registration welcome emails (Email - General). Leave empty to use default hardcoded email.
descriptions.email_template_sessionFinish: Template type for session finish emails (Email - Study Session). Leave empty to use default hardcoded email.
descriptions.email_template_sessionStart: Template type for session start emails (Email - Study Session). Leave empty to use default hardcoded email.
descriptions.email_template_studyClosed: Template type for study closed emails (Email - Study Close). Leave empty to use default hardcoded email.
descriptions.email_template_twoFactorOtp: Template type for two-factor authentication code emails (Email - General). Leave empty to use the fallback email from disk.
descriptions.email_template_verification: Template type for email verification emails (Email - General). Leave empty to use default hardcoded email.
descriptions.logo_reBgColor: Background colour for the RE section of the logo
descriptions.modal_nlp_request_timeout: The timeout for the NLP Service request in modal (frontend, ms)
descriptions.modal_nlp_rotation_timer_long: Long rotation timer duration in milliseconds.
descriptions.modal_nlp_rotation_timer_short: Short rotation timer duration in milliseconds.
descriptions.projects_default: The default project to use for new documents or studies
descriptions.rpc_moodleAPI_apiKey: The Moodle API key for the connection
descriptions.rpc_moodleAPI_apiUrl: The URL of the Moodle API
descriptions.rpc_moodleAPI_courseID: The ID of the course in Moodle from which to fetch the data
descriptions.rpc_moodleAPI_showInput_apiKey: Show the input field to allow changing the API key
descriptions.rpc_moodleAPI_showInput_apiUrl: Show the input field to allow changing the API URL
descriptions.rpc_moodleAPI_showInput_courseID: Show the input field to allow changing the course ID
descriptions.service_nlp_enabled: Whether to automatically connect to the NLP service
descriptions.service_nlp_retryDelay: The delay between retries if connection errors occurs for the NLP service (ms)
descriptions.service_nlp_test_fallback: Whether to use the fallback NLP service if the main service is not available, files on local file system are used as fallback and return examples
descriptions.service_nlp_timeout: The timeout between connection attempts for the NLP service (ms)
descriptions.service_nlp_url: The URL of the NLP service
descriptions.statistics_batch_size: Batch size for buffering statistics events before flushing to DB (requires server restart)
descriptions.statistics_tracking_mouseDebounceTime: Debounce time in milliseconds for reporting mouse move events
descriptions.system_auth_ldap_2fa_required: Require 2FA setup for LDAP login users
descriptions.system_auth_ldap_bindCredentials: LDAP bind password (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_ldap_bindDN: LDAP bind DN (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_ldap_searchBase: LDAP user search base (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_ldap_searchFilter: LDAP search filter template (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_ldap_url: LDAP server URL (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_local_2fa_required: Require 2FA setup for local login users
descriptions.system_auth_orcid_2fa_required: Require 2FA setup for ORCID login users
descriptions.system_auth_orcid_callbackUrl: ORCID callback URL (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_orcid_clientId: ORCID OAuth client id (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_orcid_clientSecret: ORCID OAuth client secret (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_orcid_sandbox: Use ORCID sandbox mode (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_redirect_baseUrl: Frontend base URL for authentication redirects (login success, OAuth callback, and 2FA verification pages)
descriptions.system_auth_saml_2fa_required: Require 2FA setup for SAML login users
descriptions.system_auth_saml_callbackUrl: SAML callback URL (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_saml_cert: SAML identity provider certificate (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_saml_entryPoint: SAML identity provider entry point (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_saml_issuer: SAML service provider issuer (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_auth_tokenExpiry_emailVerificatio: Email verification token expiration time in hours
descriptions.system_auth_tokenExpiry_passwordReset: Password reset token expiration time in hours
descriptions.system_baseUrl: The URL of the redirection for links in emails (e.g. password reset)
descriptions.system_mailService_enabled: Enable the mail service (changes require a restart of the server)
descriptions.system_mailService_sendMail_enabled: Use the sendMail function of an unix system
descriptions.system_mailService_sendMail_path: The path to the sendmail binary (default: /usr/sbin/sendmail)
descriptions.system_mailService_smtp_auth_enabled: Use authentication for the SMTP server
descriptions.system_mailService_smtp_auth_pass: The password for the SMTP server
descriptions.system_mailService_smtp_auth_user: The username for the SMTP server
descriptions.system_mailService_smtp_enabled: Use an SMTP server for sending mails (sendMail must be disabled!)
descriptions.system_mailService_smtp_host: The hostname of the SMTP server
descriptions.system_mailService_smtp_port: The port of the SMTP server
descriptions.system_mailService_smtp_secure: Use a secure connection to the SMTP server
descriptions.tags_recencySortingIsOn: Indicates whether recency based sorting for annotation tags is turned on.
descriptions.tags_tagSet_default: The default tagset to use for new annotations
descriptions.topBar_projects_hideProjectButton: Whether to hide the project button in the topBar
